title: 「果敢にチャレンジしていく」6月の京都・宮津市長選　現職の城﨑雅文氏が3選出馬表明
extracted_text: 任期満了に伴う京都府宮津市長選（6月14日告示、同21日投開票）に、現職の城﨑雅文氏（54）＝写真＝が1日、3選を目指して無所属で立候補する意向を表明した。市長選への立候補表明は城﨑氏が初めて。 城﨑氏は宮津商工会議所で記者会見。市の支援策により4年間で138人が移住したことや、商業施設への市役所移転集約に道筋をつけたことを実績として示し、「さらに暮らしやすさを実感してもらえるよう、果敢にチャレンジしていく」と述べた。 3期目の重点事業には、整備中の宮津エネルギー研究所跡地への「スマート水産業」などの誘致や、宮津湾の新たな観光誘客につなげる海上交通ネットワークの形成などを掲げた。 城﨑氏は宮津市出身。舞鶴工業高等専門学校卒業後、家業の織物業を継ぐ。市議を経て平成30年の市長選に初当選し現在2期目。
translated_text: Incumbent Masafumi Machizaki (54) declared on the 1st his intention to run as an independent for a third term in the Miyazu mayoral election in Kyoto Prefecture, scheduled to be announced on June 14 with voting on June 21. This marks Machizaki's first announcement of candidacy for the mayoral election. Machizaki held a press conference at the Miyazu Chamber of Commerce and Industry. He cited as achievements the city's support measures that facilitated 138 people relocating to the city over four years, and laying the groundwork for consolidating the city office relocation to a commercial facility. He stated, "We will continue to boldly take on challenges so that residents can further experience an improved quality of life." His priorities for a third term include attracting initiatives such as "smart fisheries" to the Miyazu Energy Research Institute site currently under development, and forming maritime transportation networks to boost new tourism in Miyazu Bay. Machizaki is a native of Miyazu. After graduating from Maizuru National College of Technology, he took over the family textile business. He served on the city council before being first elected mayor in 2018 and is currently serving his second term.
title_en: Incumbent Masafumi Machizaki Declares Third Term Bid for Miyazu Mayor in June
